pages.name: SERVICES / SYSTEM LIGHTING UPGRADE
pages.editorial_approved:
System Lighting Upgrade
As electrical and lighting technology evolves, older systems may no longer meet the needs of a
home or business. PES helps you consider upgrades to electrical capacity, wiring and lighting
controls when planning changes to your property.

More power, more possibilities
Additional appliances, equipment and lighting can place new demands on an existing electrical
system. A panel upgrade may be part of the solution when the existing capacity is not sufficient for
the property’s requirements.

Safety and stability
A reliable electrical supply is important for the safe operation and longevity of appliances and
equipment. Discuss your existing installation and planned changes so the electrical requirements
can be addressed as part of the project.

Plan for future needs
A remodel offers an opportunity to consider quality wiring and structured wiring for the devices
and features you expect to use. Modernizing infrastructure can help prepare the property for
changing technology.

Smarter lighting controls
An updated lighting control system can offer new ways to manage the light in your home or
business. Explore lighting design and installation if your upgrade also includes fixtures or controls.

Discuss your upgrade
Tell us what you want to improve, whether it is an older electrical panel, wiring during a remodel
or the lighting control system.
pages.seo_title: System Lighting Upgrade in Los Angeles | PES
pages.seo_description: Discuss lighting control updates, electrical panel capacity and wiring upgrades for Los Angeles homes and businesses with PES.

pages.editorial_approved:
Automated Window Coverings
Natural light shapes the way a room looks and feels. Premium Energy Solutions helps you plan
automated window treatments based on your goals, from simple installations to more
sophisticated requests.

Manage natural light
Adjust the amount of daylight entering your home according to the space and your preferences.
Automated coverings can make it easier to manage changing light conditions throughout the day.

Privacy and energy awareness
Window treatments help manage privacy while controlling incoming light. By managing daylight,

used.

Lutron shading systems
Through our partnership with Lutron shading systems, PES offers window treatment solutions
suited to different installation requirements, including more complex and refined spaces.

Designed around your goals
Tell us which rooms, windows and privacy needs matter most. If you are also planning lighting
changes, discuss the daylight and artificial lighting requirements together.

pages.name: SERVICES / POWER QUALITY AND ENERGY MANAGEMENT
pages.editorial_approved:
Power Quality and Energy Management
A closer look at the electrical conditions behind dependable performance and thoughtful planning.

Understanding Power Quality
Power quality describes how closely the voltage, current and frequency supplied to equipment meet the conditions that equipment needs. Changes in those conditions can influence the way connected systems operate.

Electrical Stability and Reliability
Voltage dips, interruptions and other disturbances can affect lighting, electronics and electrical equipment. Their causes and effects vary by property and connected load. A sound discussion starts with the existing installation and the demands placed on it.

Understanding Energy Management
Energy management means understanding where and when electricity is used, and planning for demand as a property evolves. That perspective can inform decisions about capacity, controls and future electrical requirements.

Modern Electrical Infrastructure
A property’s electrical infrastructure connects distribution, wiring, lighting and equipment. Remodels and new construction create opportunities to consider how those elements work together and what the property will need over time.

pages.name: SERVICES / EV CHARGER INSTALLATIONS
pages.editorial_approved:
EV Charger Installations
Premium Energy Solutions offers complete installation and energy solutions for electric vehicle
charging stations at homes and businesses. Our services include Level 2 and Level 3 chargers.

Residential charging
If you are planning a charging station for your home, tell us about the property and the proposed
location. Whether it is part of a custom build or an existing residence, the installation should be
considered in relation to your electrical requirements.

Commercial charging
For a business, share the proposed charging location and the intended use of the station. PES can
discuss the installation and energy requirements of the project.

Level 2 and Level 3 charging
We offer installation solutions for both charging levels. The appropriate charging solution depends
on the property, equipment and application; discuss the details of your project with our team.

Plan your installation
Contact us to discuss your electric vehicle charging needs and any related electrical upgrades.
